noLoss.title: Nothing recorded
noLoss.body: You can start whenever you like.

start.title: We're so sorry you went through this
start.lead: Go on whenever you're ready. Skip anything you'd rather not answer.
start.question: What happened?

types.chemical: Chemical pregnancy or a brief positive test

start.dateFuture: This date can't be in the future.
start.dateTooOld: Please pick a date within the past year.
start.stopSub: You won't see pregnancy weeks or the baby's growth any more
start.companionSub: Only that the pregnancy is not continuing

care.title: Taking care of yourself
care.warnTitle: Get help right away for these signs
care.warnFallback: Very heavy bleeding, a fever, severe pain in the abdomen, dizziness or fainting, or foul-smelling discharge.

bleeding.title: Bleeding today
bleeding.sub: Log it every day until it stops
bleeding.sheetBody: While the bleeding goes on, log it each day in your daily log. When it has stopped, mark it here.

beta.title: Beta hCG test until negative
beta.sub: Plan the repeat tests with your doctor
beta.sheetBody: Pick the day of your next test and we'll remind you the day before.
beta.datePast: Please pick today or a later day.

visit.title: Follow-up visit
visit.sub: If your doctor wants to see you again, add it here
visit.sheetBody: Add the day and time of your appointment. Only you can see it.
visit.timePast: Please pick a time that hasn't passed yet.

care.moodSupport: Sadness, guilt or numbness after this is natural, and it is not your fault.

note.title: Private note
note.sub: A place to write, just for you
note.saved: You have a note · just for you
note.label: Note
note.privacy: It's stored encrypted and no one but you can see it, not even your companion.
note.unavailable: Private notes aren't available right now. Please try again a little later.
note.unreadable: This note can't be opened any more. You can delete it and write a new one.
note.tooLong: A note can be up to {max} characters.

care.crisisFallback: If the sadness feels too heavy or you are thinking about hurting yourself, call the 1480 counselling line or the 123 social emergency line right now.

next.title: From here on
next.lead: There's no rush. You can change this in settings any time.

cycle.title: Just track my cycle for now
cycle.body: The first period usually comes 4 to 6 weeks later

ttc.title: Try to conceive again
ttc.body: Agree on the right time with your doctor

nothing.title: Nothing for now
nothing.body: Only the medical follow-up reminders stay

next.recurrentFallback: If this wasn't the first time, you can talk with your doctor about tests that look for a cause.
